name: animation-tick-batch-on-the-fox-crowd
subject: PRD-828 Phase 2: 50 single-clip rigs cross into the engine in one call a frame. Run with TN_BENCH_TARGET=web-engine so the page is bound to the owned Wasm engine; the bound is the per-rig animation crossings the batch removes, and `engineCost` makes the back end print its TN_BRIDGE_CENSUS so the classes it leaves are named.

engineCost.source: One batch a frame is the contract; two allows a frame that settles a queued tick and then queues the next. A reader that settles the queue mid-frame turns one batch into one per rig, which is the failure this bound exists to catch.
